# Orkla India Q3 PAT rises 3.8% to ₹68 crore; EBITDA jumps 18% on volume-led growth

Orkla India announced a profit of ₹68 crore for the third quarter ending December 31, 2025. This marks a 3.8% increase year-on-year. Revenue grew to ₹636 crore, supported by strong volume growth of 5.4%. EBITDA saw a significant rise of 17.7%. The company's digital commerce and international markets also performed well. Spices volumes surged over 10%.
